passages.note: Enrolled text printing the operative rate reduction in the bill Mishler sponsored; this page names no voter and no tally.

rows.reasoning: Mishler was the lead Senate sponsor of HB 1002 (2022), whose operative section lowers the individual adjusted gross income tax rate from 3.23% to 3.15% with further conditional phase-downs, and whose Section 3 repeals the utility receipts tax outright. That is a cut to the main rate every Indiana filer pays rather than narrow relief, matching the rung "Cut taxes broadly, including the main rates most people pay"; the rung below it is excluded because this is not a loophole closure or targeted carve-out. The rung above is excluded because the deeper phase-downs are conditioned on general fund revenue growth and pension fund sufficiency, and nothing in the act shrinks what government does.
